name: Low-Sodium Hospital Diet (2 g Na)
description: Institutional 2,000 mg sodium diet order for cardiac, renal and hypertension patients.

rules.title: Daily sodium limit
rules.evidence: WHO (2012) and AHA advise <2,000 mg sodium/day for adults; many hospitals implement a 2 g sodium diet order.

rules.title: Sodium per main meal
rules.evidence: Institutional policy: spread sodium so no main meal exceeds about one third of the daily limit.

rules.title: No high-sodium processed items
rules.evidence: Cured meats, canned soups and salted fried foods are excluded on 2 g sodium orders.

rules.title: Vegetable servings
rules.evidence: DASH eating pattern favours vegetables and fruit to raise potassium.

rules.title: Saturated fat share of energy
rules.evidence: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020–2025: sodium <2,300 mg/day; saturated fat <10% and added sugars <10% of energy.
